about: Qwen3.8-27B (GGUF · GSQ-RCO IQ3_S, built-in MTP head, K q8_0 / V q5_1 KV, 128K window for a 20 GB card) on llama.cpp b11160 ROCm for gfx1100, built with the q8_0/q5_1 FlashAttention kernels; from victoralcazardev/rx7900xtx-local-llm
setup: Not Docker; Linux on an RX 7900 XT (gfx1100, 20 GB). The archive is llama.cpp b11160 (70c4e1582, unmodified source) built with the ROCm 10.0.0 toolchain, GPU_TARGETS=gfx1100 and GGML_CUDA_FA_QUANTS including q8_0-q5_1 (stock builds lack the K q8_0 / V q5_1 FlashAttention kernel; BUILD.txt inside). It does not bundle the ROCm runtime: install ROCm 7.x system libraries (tested with 7.2.4 in /opt/rocm/lib: libamdhip64, hipblas, rocblas, hsa-runtime). Keep other GPU applications light: the 128K window is sized for the 20 GB card, with roughly 1 GiB left for the desktop.
